citations.assessment: The Mishnah has the bare Rabbi Yonatan and the teaching on sustaining Torah in poverty. See the competing identification in entry 1876.
The paragraph gives Abbahu together with Berekhiah in Yonatan’s name in its latter gloss. Its earlier gloss gives Berekhiah through Abbahu in Elazar’s name.
Binyamin bar Yefet attributes to Yonatan the view that the night divided of itself.
The latter gloss gives both Berekhiah and Abbahu in Yonatan’s name.
Both passages explicitly introduce Rav Dimi in the name of Rabbi Yonatan, with different formulations of the redemption obligation.
The Gabriel tradition names Yonatan. The immediately preceding geography tradition names Yochanan.
Rav Dimi reports in the name of Yonatan the teaching on departing from Torah.
The Yerushalmi explicitly gives Zeira in Yonatan’s name twice in its discussion of attenuated enactments.
